<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0"><B><A NAME="a_021"></A>Item&nbsp;9. Changes in and Disagreements With Accountants on
Accounting and Financial Disclosure</B></P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0pt 0">There were no disagreements with accountants
on accounting matters and financial disclosures for the reporting periods presented.</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0"><B><A NAME="a_022"></A>Item&nbsp;9A. Controls and Procedures</B></P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0pt 0">As of the end of the period covered by this
annual report on Form&nbsp;10-K, Old Line Bancshares&rsquo;s Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer evaluated the
effectiveness of Old Line Bancshares,&nbsp;Inc.&rsquo;s disclosure controls and procedures. Based upon that evaluation, Old Line
Bancshares,&nbsp;Inc.&rsquo;s Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer concluded that Old Line Bancshares,&nbsp;Inc.&rsquo;s
disclosure controls and procedures are effective as of December 31, 2018. Disclosure controls and procedures are controls and other
procedures that are designed to ensure that information required to be disclosed by Old Line Bancshares,&nbsp;Inc. in the reports
that it files or submits under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 is recorded, processed, summarized and reported within the time
periods specified in the SEC&rsquo;s rules and forms.</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0pt 0">In addition, there were no changes in Old Line
Bancshares,&nbsp;Inc.&rsquo;s internal control over financial reporting (as defined in Rule&nbsp;13a-15(f) under the Securities
Exchange Act of 1934) during the quarter ended December 31, 2018, that have materially affected, or are reasonably likely to materially
affect, Old Line Bancshares,&nbsp;Inc.&rsquo;s internal control over financial reporting.</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Management&rsquo;s Report On Internal Control Over Financial
Reporting</B></P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0pt 0">The management of Old Line Bancshares,&nbsp;Inc.
(&ldquo;the Company&rdquo;) is responsible for establishing and maintaining adequate internal control over financial reporting.
The internal control over financial reporting has been designed under our supervision to provide reasonable assurance regarding
the reliability of financial reporting and the preparation of the Company&rsquo;s consolidated financial statements for external
reporting purposes in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America.</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0pt 0">As permitted by guidance provided by the staff
of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the scope of management&rsquo;s assessment of internal control over financial reporting
as of December 31, 2018 has excluded Bay Bancorp, Inc., acquired on April 13, 2018. We have also excluded Bay Bancorp, Inc. from
the scope of our audit of internal control over financial reporting. Bay Bancorp, Inc. constituted 17.27 percent of consolidated
revenue (total net interest income and total non-interest income) for the year ended December 31, 2018, and 17.26 percent of consolidated
total assets as of December 31, 2018.</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0pt 0">Management has conducted an assessment of the
effectiveness of the Company&rsquo;s internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2018, utilizing the framework
established in <I>Internal Control&mdash;Integrated Framework (2013)</I> issued by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of
the Treadway Commission. Based on this assessment, management has determined that the Company&rsquo;s internal control over financial
reporting as of December 31, 2018 is effective.</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0pt 0">Dixon Hughes Goodman LLP, the registered public
accounting firm that audited the Company&rsquo;s financial statements included in this report as of December 31, 2018 and 2017
and for the three-year period ended December 31, 2018, has issued an attestation report on the Company&rsquo;s internal control
over financial reporting as of December 31, 2018 that is included elsewhere in this report.</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Policy on Audit Committee Pre-Approval of Audit and Non-Audit

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0pt 0">Old Line Bancshares,&nbsp;Inc.&rsquo;s audit
committee approves the engagement before Old Line Bancshares,&nbsp;Inc. or Old Line Bank engages the independent auditor to render
any audit or non-audit services.</P>
